rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for failing a class or exam, and it can also mean that a teacher fails a student.

example.english: I flunk my math exam this time.
example.traditional: 今次我數學考試肥佬喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 sou3 hok6 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone cannot handle or complete a non-academic challenge or task, rather than when they fail an exam.

example.english: I flunk at handling this report because it’s too hard.
example.traditional: 呢份報告太難，我搞唔掂。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 naan4 ngo5 gaau2 m4 dim6
